biggestRisk: The child-account model (server-created accounts with three secret words as the password, word reset that ends sessions, login rate-limiting, a public HTTPS backend) rests on NodeGX backend capabilities the stranger could not confirm from the folder; if createuser/updateuser/session-ending or rate limiting are not there, sign-in has to be redesigned. Secondary: a save fetched from the server goes into gala.save without passing through mend(), and switching child is not guarded against a gala run in progress.
